eyebrow: A decision the database has to make
code:
Query runs ->

  How should I actually go get this?

That choice = the execution plan.
Same table, different conditions
= a different plan, a different speed.
caption: Every query triggers a real strategy decision.

code:
Indexed lookup:
  Jump straight to matching rows

Full table scan:
  Check every row, one at a time,
  no shortcut available
caption: The distinction worth knowing at an admin level.

code:
Table: 200 rows
  Full scan: barely noticeable

Table: incident, 600,000 rows
  Full scan: checks 600,000 rows
  Indexed lookup: jumps to matches

Same logic. Very different real speed.
caption: A full scan only hurts once the table is large.

code:
Slow query + large table
+ filtered field has no covering index
= almost always a full table scan

You don't need the raw plan output
to recognize this pattern.
caption: A full scan is one of the most common, fixable causes of slowness.
